import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os
import warnings
import gc
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

# Suppress unnecessary warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set paths based on benchmark structure
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"

train_path = f"{input_dir}/train.csv"
test_path = f"{input_dir}/test.csv"
sample_path = f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv"

os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load all data
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_df = pd.read_csv(sample_path)

# Get template columns from sample submission
submit_cols = list(sample_df.columns)

# Define label mapping consistently
label_order = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
label_map = {label: i for i, label in enumerate(label_order)}
inv_label_map = {i: label for label, i in enumerate(label_order)}

# Create training labels
y_train_int = train_df["author"].map(label_map).values

# Vectorize with optimized parameters
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000,
    stop_words="english",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=2,
    norm="l2",
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])

# Stratified train/validation split BEFORE model fitting
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_vec, y_train_int, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_int
)

# Train LightGBM classifier - REMOVED INVALID 'verbose' PARAMETER
clf = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    number_of_leaves=31,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    early_stopping_rounds=100,
)
clf.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)])

# Validate on truly held-out data (untrained rows)
val_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_val)
val_labels = [0, 1, 2]
val_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_proba, labels=val_labels)

print(f"Hold-Out Validation Multi-Class Log Loss: {val_loss:.8f}")

# Generate predictions on TEST SET using same fitted model/vectorizer
test_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_test_vec)

# Apply competition-specific probability clamping before submission
test_proba = np.clip(test_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Build submission DataFrame with correct column names from sample
sub_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"].astype(str),
        **{col_name: test_proba[:, i] for i, col_name in enumerate(label_order)},
    }
)

# Save to required location
output_path = f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv"
sub_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

print(f"Submission saved successfully to {output_path}")
